25334-deerfoot-in-the-mountains.title: Deerfoot in the Mountains
25334-deerfoot-in-the-mountains.creator: Unknown
25334-deerfoot-in-the-mountains.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Deerfoot the Shawanoe, Mul-tal-la the Blackfoot, and the twin brothers, George and Victor Shelton, had completed their long journey from the Ohio River to the Pacific slope, and, standing on an elevation near the Columbia, spent hours in looking out upon the face of the mightiest ocean of the globe.

The Prince of Orange was formally and urgently invited to come to Brussels to aid them with his counsel and presence. The condemned traitor had not set foot in the capital for eleven years. We have narrated the circumstance of his departure, while the advancing trumpets of Alva's army were almost heard in the distance.

arxiv-2301-04072.title: The spectral reconstruction of inclusive rates
arxiv-2301-04072.description: Abstract A recently re-discovered variant of the Backus-Gilbert algorithm for spectral reconstruction enables the controlled determination of smeared spectral densities from lattice field theory correlation functions. A particular advantage of this approach is the a priori specification of the kernel with which the underlying spectral density is smeared, allowing for variation of its peak position, smearing width, and functional form.

arxiv-2301-05224.title: Effective spin-1 breathing kagome Hamiltonian induced by the exchange hierarchy in the maple leaf mineral bluebellite
arxiv-2301-05224.creator: Pratyay Ghosh, Tobias Müller, Yasir Iqbal, Ronny Thomale, Harald O. Jeschke
arxiv-2301-05224.description: Abstract As a highly frustrated model Hamiltonian with an exact dimer ground state, the Heisenberg antiferromagnet on the maple leaf lattice is of high theoretical interest, and a material realization is intensely sought after. We determine the magnetic Hamiltonian of the copper mineral bluebellite using density functional theory based energy mapping.

arxiv-2303-07790.title: Object Detection During Newborn Resuscitation Activities
arxiv-2303-07790.creator: Øyvind Meinich-Bache, Kjersti Engan, Ivar Austvoll, Trygve Eftestøl, Helge Myklebust, Ladislaus Blacy Yarrot, Hussein Kidanto, Hege Ersdal
arxiv-2303-07790.description: Abstract Objective: Birth asphyxia is a major newborn mortality problem in low-resource countries. International guideline provides treatment recommendations; however, the importance and effect of the different treatments are not fully explored. The available data is collected in Tanzania, during newborn resuscitation, for analysis of the resuscitation activities and the response of the newborn.

arxiv-2307-09532.title: Can Model Fusing Help Transformers in Long Document Classification? An Empirical Study
arxiv-2307-09532.creator: Damith Premasiri, Tharindu Ranasinghe and Ruslan Mitkov
arxiv-2307-09532.description: Abstract Text classification is an area of research which has been studied over the years in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Adapting NLP to multiple domains has introduced many new challenges for text classification and one of them is long document classification.

arxiv-2309-04432.title: Nonlinear stability of static Néel walls in ferromagnetic thin films
arxiv-2309-04432.creator: Antonio Capella, Christof Melcher, Lauro Morales, Ramón G. Plaza
arxiv-2309-04432.description: Abstract . The paper establishes the nonlinear (orbital) stability of static 180 180 -degree Néel walls in ferromagnetic films under the reduced wave-type dynamics for the in-plane magnetization proposed by Capella, Melcher, and Otto [ CMO07 ] . The result follows from the spectral analysis of the linearized operator, which features a challenging non-local operator.

arxiv-2311-03373.title: Unscrambling the Rectification of Adversarial Attacks Transferability across Computer Networks
arxiv-2311-03373.creator: Ehsan Nowroozi, Samaneh Ghelichkhani, Imran Haider, Ali Dehghantanha
arxiv-2311-03373.description: Abstract Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) models play a vital role in achieving state-of-the-art performances in various technological fields. CNNs are not limited to Natural Language Processing (NLP) or Computer Vision (CV) but also have substantial applications in other technological domains, particularly in cybersecurity.

arxiv-2311-13512.title: Hybrid Whale-Mud-Ring Optimization for Precise Color Skin Cancer Image Segmentation
arxiv-2311-13512.creator: Amir Hamza 1 , Badis Lekouaghet 2 , and Yassine Himeur 3
arxiv-2311-13512.description: Abstract Timely identification and treatment of rapidly progressing skin cancers can significantly contribute to the preservation of patients’ health and well-being. Dermoscopy, a dependable and accessible tool, plays a pivotal role in the initial stages of skin cancer detection. Consequently, the effective processing of digital dermoscopy images holds significant importance in elevating the accuracy of skin cancer diagnoses.

arxiv-2311-14386.title: Collective memory, consensus, and learning explained by social cohesion
arxiv-2311-14386.creator: Jeroen Bruggeman
arxiv-2311-14386.description: Abstract Humans cluster in social groups where they discuss their shared past, problems, and potential solutions; they learn collectively when they repeat activities; they establish social norms; they synchronize when they sing or dance together; and they bond through social cohesion.

arxiv-2401-05999.title: Boosting Mixed-Initiative Co-Creativity in Game Design: A Tutorial CCS: Applied computing Computer games CCS: Human-centered computing Collaborative interaction CCS: General and reference Surveys and overviews
arxiv-2401-05999.creator: Solange Margarido, Licínio Roque, Penousal Machado, Pedro Martins
arxiv-2401-05999.description: Abstract . In recent years, there has been a growing application of mixed-initiative co-creative approaches in the creation of video games. The rapid advances in the capabilities of artificial intelligence (AI) systems further propel creative collaboration between humans and computational agents.

arxiv-2507-10028.title: Universal exponents of black hole phase transition at zero-temperature limit
arxiv-2507-10028.creator: Shao-Wen Wei 1,2 , Shan-Ping Wu 1,2 , Yu-Peng Zhang 1,2 , Yu-Xiao Liu 1,2
arxiv-2507-10028.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shao-Wen Wei 1,2 , Shan-Ping Wu 1,2 , Yu-Peng Zhang 1,2 , Yu-Xiao Liu 1,2. In this work, we investigate the universal thermodynamic characteristics of black hole phase transitions at the zero-temperature limit. Our results reveal that, far below the critical point, the near zero-temperature region also exhibits universal properties.

arxiv-2605-02602.creator: Xinyi Wen, Xiao Li, Leonardo Rydin Gorjão, Veit Hagenmeyer, Benjamin Schäfer

britannica-1911-adolescence.title: Adolescence (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-adolescence.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-adolescence.description: Article 'Adolescence' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In an ideal condition children should be brought up in the country as much as possible rather than in the town. Though adults may live where they like within very wide limits and take no harm, children, even of healthy stock, living in towns, are continually subject to many minor ills, such as chronic catarrh, tonsilitis, bronchitis, and even the far graver pneumonia.

europmc-pmc4994968.creator: Brockett CL, Chapman GJ.
europmc-pmc4994968.description: This paper provides an introduction to the biomechanics of the ankle, introducing the bony anatomy involved in motion of the foot and ankle. The complexity of the ankle anatomy has a significant influence on the biomechanical performance of the joint, and this paper discusses...

pmc-10753493.title: Association of vancomycin-induced acute kidney injury with trough versus AUC monitoring in patients receiving extended durations of therapy
pmc-10753493.creator: C Tyler Pitcock, Aric Schadler, David S Burgess, Donna R Burgess, Sarah E Cotner, Jeremy Van Hoose, Eric R Gregory, Katie L Wallace
pmc-10753493.description: Objective:Vancomycin therapy is associated with an increased risk of acute kidney injury (AKI). Previous studies suggest that area under the curve (AUC) monitoring reduces the risk of AKI, but literature is lacking to support this in patients receiving longer durations of vancomycin therapy.Design:Retrospective cohort study.

pmc-11517766.title: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on food choices among the working-age adult residents of Lithuania
pmc-11517766.creator: R Arlauskas, D Austys, R Stukas
pmc-11517766.description: BackgroundThe COVID-19 pandemic affected the nutrition of various populations. Assuming that the majority of the population of working-age residents of Lithuania know healthy nutrition recommendations and that food selection criteria might serve as an indicator of the following them, we aimed to assess the food selection criteria during and after the COVID-19 pandemic among working-age adult residents of Lithuania.

pmc-11705594.title: Effects of Nonnutritive Sweeteners on the BMI of Children and Adolescents: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials and Prospective Cohort Studies
pmc-11705594.creator: Alan Espinosa, Kenny Mendoza, Hugo Laviada-Molina, Jorge Aarón Rangel-Méndez, Fernanda Molina-Segui, Qi Sun, Deirdre K Tobias, Walter C Willett, Josiemer Mattei
pmc-11705594.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The effect of nonnutritive sweeteners (NNSs) on the body mass index [BMI (in kg/m2)] of children and adolescents remains unclear despite rising consumption. Detailed systematic evaluations are warranted. We aimed to summarize evidence on NNS consumption and BMI sex- and age-specific absolute changes (kg/m2) in pediatric populations, by NNS type, study design, duration, analysis type, conflicts of interest (COI), geographical region, age, sex, and baseline BMI.

pmc-13127154.title: Nanobodies in biomedicine: from molecular characteristics to fabrication and clinical translation
pmc-13127154.creator: Cheng-Kun Cao, Xin-Yi Xu, Fei Liang, Min Yao, Yuan-Yuan Chen, Xiao-Kun Li, Zhi-Jian Su
pmc-13127154.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Nanobodies (Nbs), the antigen-binding single-domain fragments derived from camelid heavy-chain antibodies (Abs), have rapidly become a focus of biomedical research due to their compact size, high stability, strong antigen affinity, and ease of molecular engineering. This review systematically outlines their structural and functional features, current strategies for acquisition, screening, optimization, and large-scale production, and comprehensively discusses their wide-ranging applications in therapeutics, diagnostics, and basic research.

pmc-13355452.title: Ruptured abdominal aortic aneurysm in 14-year-old female with tuberous sclerosis
pmc-13355452.creator: Austin Clements, Sellers Boudreau, Benjamin Pearce
pmc-13355452.description: Abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAAs) in pediatric populations with tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) are limited to sporadic case reports and small series within the distant literature. TSC is a multisystem autosomal-dominant genetic disorder with variable penetrance characterized by benign tumors and dysplastic lesions in multiple organs. Although not well understood, there remains a critical association of TSC with pediatric AAAs.

pmc-13361208.title: Highly transparent PAA-functionalized porous silica coatings with underwater superoleophobicity and oil-fouling resistance
pmc-13361208.creator: Lianyi Xu, Jinlong Li, Rongbin Li, Xuemin Lu, Miaosen Yang, Pan Gao, Liping Tong, Su Zhao, Haiyang Jiang
pmc-13361208.description: Transparent underwater superoleophobic coatings hold great promise for underwater optics and marine devices, but their practical application is hindered by the inherent conflict between optical transparency, mechanical robustness, and oil-repellent durability. Here, we report a high-performance transparent underwater superoleophobic (TUS) coating designed by covalently anchoring high-molecular-weight poly(acrylic acid) chains onto a robust, porous nano-silica scaffold.

pmc-13632049.title: Service continuity of community-based health and social care organisations in times of disaster and health emergencies: a mapping review
pmc-13632049.creator: Farhana Haque Nila, Michelle Villeneuve, Kuo-Yi Jade Chang, Parvathi Subramaniam
pmc-13632049.description: BackgroundThe physical and economic impacts of disaster and health emergencies have become a global concern that continues to generate discussion regarding disaster preparedness, response, and mitigation strategies. Maintaining continuity of services during these challenging and dynamic circumstances requires adequate organisational preparedness.

pmc-13637363.title: Off-label use of dapagliflozin in a dog with recurrent calcium oxalate urolithiasis: a case report
pmc-13637363.creator: Jay Pakhawala
pmc-13637363.description: BackgroundCalcium oxalate (CaOx) urolithiasis is a common and recurrent condition in dogs, typically managed with dietary modification, thiazide diuretics, and potassium citrate. In human medicine, sodium–glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors such as dapagliflozin are increasingly used to manage diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease and have been shown to alter urinary factors associated with nephrolithiasis.
